Package domain

Class GameMode

java.lang.Object
domain.GameMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArcadeMode, TournamentMode
public abstract class GameMode extends Object implements Serializable
Game mode: how many matches are played. It keeps the configuration chosen by the users and creates each Match with it. A new mode is a new subclass.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

    • GameMode

      public GameMode(GameCharacter leftCharacter, Stats leftStats, PlayerController leftController, GameCharacter rightCharacter, Stats rightStats, PlayerController rightController, MatchType type, String resolution, BallSkin skin, String stadium)
      Keeps the configuration of the game.
      Parameters:
      leftCharacter - character of the left player
      leftStats - stats of the left player
      leftController - who controls the left player
      rightCharacter - character of the right player
      rightStats - stats of the right player
      rightController - who controls the right player
      type - rule to end each match
      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"
      skin - ball chosen to play
      stadium - stadium of the matches ("default", "rain"...)
